tokens.name: brand-coral
tokens.usage: Brand coral from the app icon. Decorative fills, the cover, illustrations and the icon's own field; 2.8:1 on `background` (light), so never small text on white — use `action` for text and controls.

tokens.name: brand-plum
tokens.usage: Deep plum ground of the icon and brand moments (cover, splash, marketing). Not a required app-wide background. `brand-ivory` and `brand-coral` read on it (16.9:1 / 6.6:1).

tokens.name: brand-ivory
tokens.usage: Ivory from the icon's second speech bubble. Decorative accents and text on `brand-plum`; not a UI surface.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page/screen ground (Figma Backgrounds/Primary). In SwiftUI this is systemBackground — keep it semantic, this hex is the prototype fallback.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped content, sidebars, chips, secondary buttons, spec boxes (Figma Backgrounds/Secondary; secondarySystemBackground).

tokens.name: elevated
tokens.usage: Content raised above `background`: mini-player, bottom navigation capsule, selected sidebar item in light theme. VoxaFrame proposal.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `background`, `surface` and `elevated` (≥13.9:1 in both themes); also the fill of a selected FilterChip (text in `background`).

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Metadata, captions, channel/date lines, inactive navigation on `background`, `surface`, `elevated` (≥5.5:1 light, ≥7:1 dark). Opaque prototype fallback for native .secondary.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Contrast-safe coral for actions: primary button fill, plain-button and selected-nav text, toggle on, progress. Text on `background`/`surface` ≥5.2:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: onAction
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `action` fill (5.8:1 light, 8.9:1 dark). Dark theme uses plum, not white.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Opaque separators and card outlines (Figma Separators/Opaque). Decorative only, 1.5–1.8:1 — never the only indicator that something is a control.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3–4px offset; ≥5.2:1 on every surface in both themes. Native tvOS focus stays system-owned.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed/confirmed status text and symbols, always with a label and a check — never color alone. ≥5.9:1 on `background`/`surface`.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings (paused, limited, fallback in use) with a label and a warning symbol; dark yellow-brown in light theme, never pale yellow text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions (Delete file, failed download). Distinct from `action` by label and role, not hue alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Black at 72% — only over arbitrary video under white controls (player bars, duration badges).

tokens.name: onMedia
tokens.usage: Text and transport icons on `scrim` over video; verify against the lightest frame.

styles.name: largeTitle
styles.usage: Compact screen title (Home, Search…). Native: Font.largeTitle; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title1
styles.usage: Section title; screen title on iPad. Native: Font.title; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title2
styles.usage: Shelf heading, large-block card title. Native: Font.title2; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: title3
styles.usage: Title of the open video. Native: Font.title3; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Buttons and important rows. Native: Font.headline; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Main text. Native: Font.body; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary paragraph. Native: Font.callout; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: Video card title/meta block. Native: Font.subheadline; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Channel, date, metadata. Native: Font.footnote; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: caption1
styles.usage: Duration, short label. Native: Font.caption; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: caption2
styles.usage: Optional compact label. Native: Font.caption2; scales with Dynamic Type.

styles.name: macBody
styles.usage: Custom Mac layouts only; otherwise system body/control styles.

styles.name: tvTitle
styles.usage: TV screen title. Proposal, not an Apple standard; weight follows title1. Evaluate from viewing distance.

styles.name: tvHeading
styles.usage: TV shelf heading; weight follows title2.

styles.name: tvBody
styles.usage: TV body text and card titles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: icon-to-label inside a pill, meta line offsets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, stacked controls in the mini-player and bottom stack.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Mini-player inner gap, sidebar item spacing, card title top margin.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: iPhone content margin; default card and row padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: iPad margin; grid gap between video cards; section-head spacing.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Mac margin; spec-box and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: TV focus gap between cards; section gaps on large canvases.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large vertical rhythm between sections.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on wide layouts.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Small content: thumbnails in compact rows, duration badges (5px in the prototype), inline tags. Content only — system controls keep native geometry.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Video thumbnails and cards, translation status block, cards on every platform (18px on TV is a composition detail).

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Large panels: hero block, player frame, spec boxes, iPad/Mac window previews.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, filter chips, avatar and other capsules.

size.note: Hit targets and platform margins (logical pt). Runtime safe areas win.

tokens.name: touchTarget
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on iPhone/iPad; the visible glyph may be smaller.

tokens.name: macTarget
tokens.usage: Pointer target on native macOS.

tokens.name: tvTarget
tokens.usage: Focusable target height on Apple TV.

tokens.name: iphoneMargin
tokens.usage: Horizontal content margin on iPhone (Figma Margin).

tokens.name: ipadMargin
tokens.usage: Horizontal content margin on iPad (Figma Margin).

tokens.name: macMargin
tokens.usage: Content margin in the Mac window — starting value.

tokens.name: tvMarginX
tokens.usage: Horizontal TV safe margin proposal; check against tvOS safe areas.

tokens.name: tvMarginY
tokens.usage: Vertical TV safe margin proposal.

tokens.name: cardMinWidth
tokens.usage: Minimum video-card width on iPad/Mac; drop a column instead of shrinking below it.
